translations.web: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
translations.bsb: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
translations.kjv: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
translations.asv: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they leave nothing till the morrow.
